title: Experiment plans
description: A plan is a saved run configuration that you pick or save on the "New run" page. Every change makes a new revision; runs that used an old revision keep its values. Only the creator can edit; others can copy and then edit. Once archived, a plan can no longer be picked; existing runs are not affected.
empty: No plans yet. Fill in a configuration on the "New run" page, then save it as a plan.
